scope: Effective investigation-plan bounds and model-only candidate wire request/schema/decode/fallback paths. Not new real-model F1, whole-runtime readiness, helper API acceptance, or release/adoption approval.

conclusions.basis: Actual run_natural_investigation passes config.policy.max_targets into traced/untraced request. minItems=1/maxItems=effective bound and unique target ID vs capability ID guidance are added. Existing exact-key constraints, token max, seed and admission remain. All 14 saved oversize and 2 duplicate-ID plans remain rejected rather than truncated/relabelled.

Same private DTO defines primary and fallback schema. Explicit claims array required; [] allowed. Closed top/claim/proposition/inference structs reject unknown fields. JSON Value preflight requires object structures and string proposed_state, followed by strict decoding of unchanged original text. Six string enum forms pass; six externally-tagged object forms fail.

Object preflight does not replace original text with reserialized Value; second strict decode still detects duplicate root/claim/proposition/inference keys. Existing acceptable non-JSON suffix is preserved; second JSON value and JSON-like truncated suffix still rejected.

Candidate bad shapes enter existing single fallback. Malformed fallback stays protocol failure; explicit empty claims is accepted without extra request. Actual CLI mock-adapter test filters passed, with no external API.

Only CLI main.rs changed. Core ReasoningCandidate defaults and enum representation remain compatible; private DTO conversion preserves fields. Final renderer parser, investigation action/intent parsing, final truth gates, helper API sources and published old evaluation artifacts are not altered. Schema-only acceptance is not semantic correctness.

limits: No new model/API execution or F1 measurement. Saved-response parser replay does not predict future model accuracy.
Full provider budget/reservation and execution admission review is a separate operational scope. This result does not authorize a fresh live run by itself.
Earlier diagnosis of duplicate snapshot acquisition, Reject short circuit, selectors and explanation loss remains unresolved by this two-part change.
The current consumed24 score and incomplete observation states remain unchanged.
No claim that all CLI phases or operating systems were dynamically revalidated; other-phase isolation is based on the diff and selected route tests.
